title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale (ViT)
description: Proved Transformers work for vision without convolutional inductive biases. Given enough data, pure attention beats CNNs. Unified the architectural language of vision and language.
authors: Dosovitskiy, Beyer, Kolesnikov, Weissenborn, Zhai, Unterthiner, Dehghani, Minderer, Heigold, Gelly, Uszkoreit, Houlsby
